/--
Bitwise and. Usually accessed via the `&&&` operator.

Each bit of the resulting value is set if the corresponding bit is set in both of the inputs.
-/
@[extern "lean_nat_land"]
def land : @& Nat → @& Nat → Nat := bitwise and
